slide1.title: Welcome to Party It!
slide1.body: The funniest card game to liven up any party. No internet required!

slide2.title: How it works
slide2.body: Register the players, shuffle the deck, and draw cards. Each card brings a different challenge. Have fun and play fair!

slide3.title: Special rules
slide3.body: Shields block penalties. Modifiers change the game rules. Hot Potato has a surprise timer. Good luck!

help.general: Draw cards and follow the instructions. The current player decides who gets penalized when the card asks to.
help.modifiers: Modifiers are special rules that stay active until they are removed. Keep an eye on the banner at the top of the screen.
help.shields: Shields automatically block the next penalty you receive. Each shield protects you once.
help.hotPotato: The Hot Potato has a hidden timer. Pass it fast! Whoever is holding it when the time runs out gets penalized.
help.bathroom: The Bathroom benefit allows a trip to the restroom without a penalty. Use it wisely!
